title: The Brand New Notebook Night
skyStory: Zero percent. The moon is completely new, invisible in Virgo, sitting at the very start of a clean notebook page. Every planet holds its breath, waiting for the first word. Mercury sharpens a pencil. Saturn smooths the paper flat. Mars is already trying to write in pen. The stars are quiet, polite, and very, very bright.

reading: New moon, new page. Tonight is perfect for writing one intention for October. Not ten. One. The [[Knight of Wands]] has been reversed in your spread all year, and he has a single message: aim. Pick the one target that matters most and write it in your best handwriting.

During the day, someone will offer you a small gift or kindness, a coffee, a hand, a ride. Receive it without fuss. The new moon is the universe's way of starting fresh, and that includes your old habit of deflecting help. Start fresh. Say thank you and let it land.
joel.mission: Write one October intention tonight in a brand new notebook or on a fresh page, then close it until tomorrow.
joel.omen: A blank piece of paper blowing across your path. A clean start is available, and it is yours.

reading: The moon is fully new, and the darkness at the shore tonight is soft and deep and full of possibility. Your Capricorn patience has carried you through September beautifully, and now it is time to plant the next seed.

Your crossing, the [[Six of Swords]] journey, gets a new map tonight. Write down where you want to land by the solstice. Not the whole route, just the destination. Joel will help you row. The water is calm. The stars are your compass, and the Mountain knows how to read them.
nancy.mission: Write where you want to be by the solstice on one card, and tuck it into a book you love.
nancy.omen: A buoy light blinking steadily across dark water. Your direction is true; keep steering.

together.text: Exchange your new moon intentions, one each, and promise to check in on them at the full moon. Write them somewhere you can both see. The stars are taking notes and they have excellent handwriting.
